duplicates.interpretation: Exact duplicates across material_version, instance_version, and original_data are alternate copies of the same source imagery; they must not be treated as independent training images.

instance_version.screening_method: Exact SHA-256 and dHash overlap are checked between supplied train/val splits. For videos spanning both splits, nearby frame numbers (gap <= 5) with dHash distance <= 8 are flagged.

material_version.screening_method: Exact SHA-256 and dHash overlap are checked between supplied train/val splits. For videos spanning both splits, nearby frame numbers (gap <= 5) with dHash distance <= 8 are flagged.

uieb.challenging_policy: The challenging folder is inventoried separately and is not included in paired training data.
